topPRs.title: eth: cancel 082/083/089, keep eth/084 U21 calldata, re-pin 084-087
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- **eth/082, eth/083, eth/089** → `CANCELLED`.
- **eth/084 (U21)** stays eth/084 with **byte-identical calldata**. That calldata sets OP Mainnet's `SUPER_PERMISSIONED` proposer to `0xc27ba3E0Fc01567a5E57Ae0c391AA98cECBA5bE0`, which the template previously read from fork state after eth/083. With eth/083 cancelled, the value is now pinned in `config.toml` through a new optional `[[proposerOverrides]]` entry, so U21 performs the proposer rotation itself.
- **`OPCMUpgradeV900`**: optional `proposerOverrides` (per chain). Used for the game-5 args and for the standard-validator input. No override → unchanged behaviour. Setup tests added.
- **Nonce re-pins** (live: L1PAO 48, FUS 79, SC 75), domain/message hashes, root safe hashes and `approvedHashes` keys regenerated:

| Task | L1PAO | FUS | SC | Calldata |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| eth/084 | 49 → 48 | 81 → 79 | 76 → 75 | unchanged |
| eth/085 | 50 → 49 | 82 → 80 | 77 → 76 | unchanged |
| eth/086 | – | 83 → 81 | – | unchanged |
| eth/087 | 51 → 50 | 84 → 82 | 78 → 77 | unchanged |

## Verification

- eth/084 simulated calldata equals the calldata already in `VALIDATION.md` (17,354 hex chars, identical).
- `just simulate-stack eth 087-soneium-fee-vault council` and `… foundation` pass (084 → 087).
- `forge test --match-path test/template/OPCMUpgradeV900Setup.t.sol`: 15 passed.

## Notes

- Signers must sign the new eth/084 hashes; earlier signatures are invalid.
- Alternative to #1627.
- #1588 (eth/088 rollback) pins FUS 84 and needs 82 after this.
